declarations: R1: no stance below rests on a bracket. R41: no Valen flag is a reason. market_void is null throughout: my method carries no market kill line.
Breaks at the test (C7) get ACT_NOW on a sign-of-strength buy stop above bar_high (C12); names away from value get WAIT for the Creek test (R2, C3, C15).

trigger.plain: Buy stop: an hourly close above yesterday's high, follow-through on the break bar.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close under structure_shift_ref (the Creek), or a trade under bar_low.
decisions.reason: Fresh BOS at the test (C7), wide bar on rvol_20d 1.31, W HH/HL 0.7% under the 20-wk high, H1 96% of range: break genuine on my grade (C5).

trigger.plain: Buy stop: an hourly close above yesterday's high.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close under structure_shift_ref (the Creek), or a trade under bar_low.
decisions.reason: Fresh BOS over the Creek, price at the test; wide bar on rvol_20d 1.36, D HH/HL, 0.4% under the highs. W mixed keeps conviction modest.

trigger.plain: Wait for a pullback into the broken Creek, then a top-third close on volume.

decisions.wrong_if: Close back under structure_shift_ref by half an ATR, or a bearish change of character.
decisions.reason: TREND, W/D mixed, 1.7% under the highs; far from value (ext_atr20 4.27): no chase (C15), join on the test.

trigger.plain: Buy stop: an hourly close above yesterday's high, proving the break.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close back under structure_shift_ref (an upthrust).
decisions.reason: Fresh BULLISH_BOS, at the test by definition; D HH/HL, 1.2% under the highs. H1 at 60% of range is not a clear sign of strength, so follow-through is required (C12).

trigger.plain: Wait for the test of the broken Creek or a small base above it, then a strong close.

decisions.reason: W/D HH/HL, 0.9% under the highs; the furthest from value here (ext_atr20 5.11). Trend good, location poor: wait (R2, C15).

trigger.plain: Wait for the test of the broken Creek, then a top-third close on volume.

decisions.wrong_if: Close back under structure_shift_ref by half an ATR, or a bearish change of character.
decisions.reason: W/D HH/HL, 0.6% under the highs; away from value (ext_atr20 4.55) on ordinary volume (day_vol 1.16). Join on the test (C3, C7).

trigger.plain: Held: keep; add only on a test of the broken Creek with a strong close.

decisions.reason: Held, KEEP: trend intact, D HH/HL, 0.3% under the highs, H1 89% of range; bias long while above the Creek (C9). Away from value (ext_atr20 3.48) for adding.
